interaction: Choose a goal (strength, fat loss, fitness or sport), 2–5 training days and an experience level to generate an illustrative 12-week calendar of colour-coded sessions with planned deload and retest weeks, a session-mix breakdown and an animated volume/intensity chart; tap or arrow-key through any day to see that session's detail.
notes: The generated plan is an illustration of program structure (labelled as such), not a prescription.
